task: The retail commercial team's analysts query raw invoice tables directly, and their numbers disagree. Build a small star schema with staging, dimensions and a sales fact, make the daily load safe to rerun, add quality checks, and publish one reporting view. Prove with checks that its monthly sales reconcile exactly to the source invoices.

produce.name: Control totals
produce.about: Invoices, lines, customers, products, anonymous lines and net value from the source.

produce.name: Star schema
produce.about: Staging copies, customer, product and date dimensions, and a sales fact with one row per line.

produce.name: Rerunnable load
produce.about: An insert that adds only missing lines and changes nothing on a second run.

produce.name: Quality checks and reporting view
produce.about: A view of four named checks and a monthly sales view built on the fact.

produce.name: Warehouse handoff
produce.about: Build decisions, validation results and known limitations.

summaries.understand-data: Count the rows in each source table and find the keys the fact will need.
summaries.profile: Record the control totals the warehouse must reproduce.
summaries.build-staging: Copy the raw invoices and lines into staging tables, unchanged.
summaries.build-dimensions: Build customer, product and date dimensions with surrogate keys.
summaries.build-fact: Build a sales fact with one row per invoice line.
summaries.incremental-load: Load the missing last month so a second run adds nothing.
summaries.quality-checks: Publish four named checks as a view anyone can query.
summaries.publish-reporting: Publish a monthly sales view that reconciles to the source.
summaries.synthesis: Decide what makes the warehouse trustworthy and which risk remains.
summaries.report: Hand over decisions, validation evidence and limitations.

problems: About a quarter of invoice lines have no customer, so an inner join to customers drops them.
Cancellation invoices, and some lines on sale invoices, have negative quantities, so net and gross sales differ.
Some products have no category, so an inner join to departments drops their lines.
Many customers have several segment versions, so joining the full history multiplies their lines.
December 2011 holds only its first nine days.
